title: GoOrganicAfrica 44-country calculator data readiness matrix
scope: Tracks evidence-to-calculator completion for the 42 research-only countries outside the 12 calculator-enabled profiles. The 44-country evidence register includes Botswana (mixed-source operational) and Equatorial Guinea (benchmark-only operational); neither is fully locally data-ready. This is a work queue, not a certification of data quality.
safeguards: Do not modify the 10 original active country profiles or calculator formulas in this workstream.
Botswana is calculator-enabled in mixed-source mode; do not describe its 17 commodity profiles as fully locally validated.
Do not activate any other country until required commodity-level values have provenance, dates, units, regional scope and validation.
Never fill missing prices, yields or costs with invented values.
Keep national statistics, market prices, farmgate prices and modelled estimates clearly distinguished.

These improve market and energy reference evidence but do not establish producer netbacks, agricultural tariffs, input costs, regional yields or complete enterprise budgets. survey_table_extraction.survey_quality: 2024/25 PHS covered eight rural provinces, selected 58,000 farming households across 1,562 rural wards, and achieved a 93.2% response rate. It collected area harvested and total crop harvested at questionnaire level, but published result tables reviewed do not expose matched crop-area/yield cross-tabs.
survey_table_extraction.soybean_table_conflict: Table 3.7 provincial soybean rows sum to 57,750 MT while its printed national row says 7,750 MT. Table 3.8 sector total is 57,750 MT. The evidence strongly indicates a national-row typographical error, but keep official clarification pending rather than silently overwriting the published value.
survey_table_extraction.calculator_use: Use provincial production quantities as calibration/context and crop-mix evidence only. Do not derive yields, hectare budgets, or expected farm output from these quantities without the matched harvested-area microdata/cross-tabulations. Cereal seed-use tonnage is not a seed rate per hectare.
